reasoning: Contains four distinct schema extensions with non-trivial dependency ordering, a two-tier edge model (entity-to-entity vs thought-to-thought) that is easy to conflate, domain-specific graph vocabulary (reasoning relation types, temporal validity semantics, sensitivity_tier filtering), hard prerequisite checks with fail-fast exceptions, diverging RLS postures across sub-schemas, and non-obvious NULL handling in the upsert RPC.

module_summary.purpose: Community-contributed idempotent SQL migrations that extend the Open Brain Supabase database with knowledge-graph tables, enrichment columns, RPCs, triggers, and RLS policies
key_concepts: Two-tier edge model (entity edges vs thought edges)
Reasoning relation vocabulary (supports, contradicts, evolved_into, supersedes, depends_on, related_to)
Two-phase full-text search (GIN tsvector + ILIKE fallback)
